title: On Acquiring a small piece of land
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：acquire　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 acquire 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the researcher ① acquired a small piece of land before dawn, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② acquires a small piece of land in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ acquire a small piece of land at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ acquired a small piece of land before — a line in the paper for February 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Acquiring a small piece of land before dawn, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ acquire the local accent in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Acquire the local accent at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ acquires the local accent before dawn every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ acquired a small piece of land again when nobody else would.

⑩ To acquire a small piece of land, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody acquires a small piece of land in public again and somebody must acquire a small piece of land before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 得到（一般过去式 acquired a small piece of land：1990 年研究员头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 得到（一般现在 acquires a small piece of land：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 得到（不定式 to acquire a small piece of land：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 得到（过去完成时 had acquired a small piece of land：1984 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 得到（动名词 acquiring a small piece of land 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 学到（acquire the local accent：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去学到当地的口音）
G. v. 学到（acquire the local accent：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 得到（后段两处：新来的学生照例 acquires the local accent，而母亲又一次 acquired a small piece of land）

answers.why: acquire 意为“得到”，1990 年研究员天没亮就得到一小块地，那是实验室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 acquired。
acquire 意为“得到”，自那以后研究员当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 acquires。
acquire 意为“得到”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯得到一小块地”，此处为不定式 to acquire a small piece of land。
acquire 意为“得到”，研究报告里 二月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人得到过，故用过去完成时 had acquired。
acquire 意为“得到”，研究员说“得到一小块地这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 acquiring a small piece of land 作主语。
acquire 意为“学到”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去学到当地的口音”，should ever 之后用原形 acquire the local accent。
acquire 意为“学到”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻学到当地的口音（acquire the local accent at once），以后再也不要提起。
acquire 意为“得到”，新来的学生每个学期都照例学到当地的口音，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 acquires。
acquire 意为“得到”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就得到一小块地，用一般过去式 acquired 叙述。
acquire 意为“得到”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要得到一小块地，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和实验室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，研究员天没亮就得到一小块地；实验室里每一个学生都说这是头一回。（acquired a small piece of land）
多年以后，研究员仍当着众人面做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（acquires a small piece of land）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯得到一小块地这件事本身。（to acquire a small piece of land）
早在 1984 年就有人得到一小块地，二月那天研究报告上的一行字就是证据。（had acquired a small piece of land）
研究员说过，天没亮就得到一小块地这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（acquiring a small piece of land 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻学到当地的口音，以后再也不要提起。（acquire the local accent，祈使句）
answers: In 1990 the researcher acquired a small piece of land before dawn, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three terms on, the researcher still acquires a small piece of land in public without being asked.
My mother said later that to acquire a small piece of land at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had acquired a small piece of land long before 1997, and the line in the paper for February proves it.
Acquiring a small piece of land before dawn, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Acquire the local accent at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 acquire 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the researcher acquired a small piece of land before dawn, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher acquires a small piece of land in public whenever the lab asks.
Acquiring a small piece of land before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever acquire the local accent in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next lab acquires the local accent before dawn every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother acquired a small piece of land again, and the lab remembered that half.
